_note: English solar terms. line: what this term means and how to spend it. mine is said to you: {term} is the term name and {wx} its element; xi = your lucky element is in season, ji = a draining one, neutral = neither.

mine.xi: From {term}, {wx} is in season — and it's one of your lucky elements. A good time to take the lead and push your plans forward.
mine.ji: From {term}, {wx} is in season, and it tends to drain you. Slow your pace these two weeks and look after yourself first.
mine.neutral: From {term}, {wx} is in season. It neither helps nor drains you — just go at your own pace.

立春.line: Spring starts today. The world is just waking up — set a small goal for the year and take the first step.

雨水.line: The rains pick up and the ground softens. Build your strength slowly; water your plans well and don't rush the results.

惊蛰.line: The first spring thunder wakes the sleeping insects. Get moving and restart whatever you've been putting off.

春分.line: Day and night are equal and spring is half over. Find your balance — half for work, half for life.

清明.line: Clear skies, fresh green everywhere. Get outside, sort through old things, and think of the people far away.

谷雨.line: Rain that feeds the grain — the last stop of spring. Tend what you've planted and let it grow.

立夏.line: Summer begins and everything grows. Put in a little extra and let your ideas take shape.

小满.line: The grain is filling out but not yet ripe. A little full is just right — be content, and leave room to grow.

芒种.line: Busy harvesting one crop and planting the next. Wrap things up while you start something new; don't drop either.

夏至.line: The longest day of the year, when the light is strongest. Express yourself boldly — and take an afternoon break.

小暑.line: The heat is building. Slow down a little and find a cool corner to settle your mind.

大暑.line: The hottest stretch of the year. Do less, drink more water, and save your strength for what matters.

立秋.line: Autumn begins and the heat starts to fade. Refocus and sort out the first half of the year.

处暑.line: The heat ends here. Get back into rhythm, go to bed a little earlier, and welcome the crisp autumn.

白露.line: Dew turns white and mornings grow cool. Add a layer, and look after the people around you.

秋分.line: Day and night are equal again, and autumn is half over. Gather your harvest, and tell yourself: well done.

寒露.line: The dew grows cold and autumn deepens. Settle in with a book and set your worries down for a while.

霜降.line: The first frost — the last leg of autumn. Wrap up and file away; finish what needs finishing.

立冬.line: Winter begins and everything is stored away. Rest and recharge, and keep this year's gains safe.

小雪.line: The first light snow. Gather by the fire, talk slowly, and stay a little longer with the people who matter.

大雪.line: Heavy snow and a quiet world. Keep a low profile, rest well, and save your strength for next year.

冬至.line: The shortest day of the year — from here, every day gets longer. Be with family, and make a wish for the year ahead.

小寒.line: The cold deepens and the plum blossoms open. Hang in there: the coldest days mean you're nearly through.

大寒.line: The last solar term of the year — winter ends and spring is on its way. Say goodbye to the old and close out the year well.
